MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The portable hard drive fits my laptop and computing projects because extra storage and backups would serve a practical purpose.",
    "Storage is a plausible connection to my memory-card purchases, although I would still check whether this drive suits my devices."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Streaming sticks do not address the connectivity, maintenance, and organization needs reflected in my recent accessories; an HDMI cable alone does not mean I want a streaming upgrade.",
    "Alexa speakers, displays, and a smart plug assume an interest in home automation that I have not shown.",
    "My Kindle interaction does not imply that I need a general-purpose tablet or another screen."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My use of Amazon-branded accessories and a Kindle seems to have been stretched into interest in the broader Amazon device family.",
    "The suggestions treat electronics as interchangeable, even though a computer accessory and a voice-controlled display serve very different purposes for me."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My recent Ethernet adapter and cables point toward practical wired connectivity for my computing setup.",
    "The headphone mount, electric duster, cable organizers, and laptop backpack suggest that maintaining and organizing my equipment matters to me.",
    "My Raspberry Pi, matching case, and power supply show interest in parts that work together for a specific project, rather than unrelated standalone gadgets."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The suggestions recognize my interest in electronics but mostly miss my current focus on useful additions to my computer setup."
}
